name: Customer Feedback Report
description: Turns a CSV of customer reviews into a report: sentiment table, top problems and priorities, and draft replies to unhappy customers. Inputs: feedback_csv, report_path.

task.instruction:
Below are customer reviews as CSV with the columns id,date,customer,rating,comment.
Make a markdown table with the columns: ID | Customer | Rating | Sentiment | Main topic.
Decide Sentiment ONLY from the rating: 4 or 5 = Positive, 3 = Neutral, 1 or 2 = Negative.
Main topic is 2 to 4 words describing what the comment is about.
Write exactly one row per review, in the same order. Output only the table.

Reviews:
{{feedback.content}}

You are a customer-insights analyst. Use the reviews and the classification table below.
Write three short markdown sections and nothing else:
## What customers love
(up to 3 bullets, based only on Positive reviews)
## Top problems
(up to 3 bullets, based only on Negative and Neutral reviews, most urgent first. Group reviews that describe the same problem. For each, state the count and list the review IDs. Do not group unrelated reviews together.)
## Recommended actions
(3 bullets, each a concrete next step for the team)

Reviews:
{{feedback.content}}

Classification:
{{classified}}

Look at the rating column of the reviews below. Write a reply ONLY for customers whose rating is exactly 1 or 2. Do not write replies for ratings 3, 4 or 5.
For each such customer, write a short, warm reply (2 or 3 sentences) in the form:
**To <customer>:** <reply>
Apologise, name the specific problem they raised, and say a teammate will follow up. Never promise a refund or a date.
Output only the replies.

Reviews:
{{feedback.content}}
